Candidates should manage their time carefully, allocating an equal amount of time for each section of the
paper. Within this allocation of time, candidates are further advised to devote a set amount of time to
identifying factors for writing, planning to write, writing, checking, and correcting.
When reading the questions, candidates should concentrate on the instructions and should carefully interpret
and deconstruct the question. They should look at the key instructions in the questions they choose. For

Quite a number of submissions self-penalised on the grounds of rubric infringement: some responses were
appreciably short of the minimum word limit. Candidates should practise writing time-limited tasks to a
specific word length.
